translation: Flavor pungent, level-natured, poisonous. Its chief action is to settle the spirit-shen, strengthen the bone marrow, dredge and free the five viscera, dispel pathogenic toxic qi; taking it makes one an immortals' adept. It grows in Yizhou; gather according to the proper season.
translator_notes: 金屑 realgar gold filings; 邪毒瓦斯 glossed as poisonous qi (毒氣).
